posts.text: Our team won 1st place overall at Evidence Jam 2026 Causapalooza, an ecology hackathon :D The problem: what we know about ecological restoration is scattered across thousands of papers, reports and practitioners' heads. For a practitioner, turning that research into decisions they can act on is slow and messy. We built 𝗪𝗵𝗶𝗺𝘀𝘆, an offline evidence explorer that helps restoration practitioners find out what the research says about 3 key ecological questions. For each finding, it shows: 📈 Direction
